meta.note: MREDC = ДомКлик Moscow residential price index, PRICE ONLY (no rent) and ~WEEKLY (smoothed) — measured volatility/drawdown are structurally understated vs a traded asset; the investable rental-ЗПИФ wrapper carries illiquidity + 1-3%/yr fees MREDC hides. The ~+8.5%/yr appreciation was largely subsidised-mortgage (льготная ипотека) driven — NOT a forward expectation. Index legs carry the MCFTRR MSK->UTC T-1 date convention; the cert shifts them +1 day.
